job_id.description: An identifier for the migration job.

public_application_id.description: The ID of v3 application this job is running for.

status.description:
The state of the job.

- **Pending**: The job has been created, but not started. Batch clone runs only after the linked
snapshot job is completed.
- **Running**: The job is currently running.
- **Completed**: The job has successfully finished all migrations.
- **Failed**: _All_ migrations failed.
- **Partial**: The job successfully migrated _some_ accounts, but some could not be migrated or were created as "placeholder" grants.

count_all.description: A total number of accounts to be migrated. The total is a sum of the successful and failed migrations.

count_success.description: The number of accounts that were successfully migrated.

count_failed.description: The number of accounts that were unable to migrate.

count_warning.description: The number of accounts that were migrated as invalid grants ("placeholder" grant ready for re-authentication).

created_at.description: The time when the job was created, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.

updated_at.description: The time the job was updated, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.

linked_job_id.description: The bulk migration tool creates two separate jobs that run one after the other. This ID links them together.
